negative_reviews.author: Regan Roberts
negative_reviews.text: I got SEVERE FOOD POISONING after eating here last Wednesday. This restaurant has been warned by other customers multiple times about serving food at improper temperatures going back 5 months, as several 1-star comments here show. The ramen I got should have been served piping hot as per Japanese tradition. It was just warm enough for me to not bother sending it back. HUGE mistake. I'm now on day four of being sick with diarrhea, nausea, fatigue, and stomach cramps. It is NOT WORTH THE RISK to eat at a restaurant like this that demonstrates such EXTREME NEGLIGENCE when it comes to protecting the public! Some 180 people every year DIE from food poisoning in the UK alone and this establishment is obviously NOT taking its warnings seriously! I have filed a complaint with the Aberdeen City Council as should anyone else who has been served food at an improper temperature regardless of whether they got sick or not. AVOID THIS RESTAURANT AT ALL COSTS!!!

negative_reviews.author: Gary Cairns
negative_reviews.text:
Went in for lunch with my wife. First time we've been. Ordered the soft shell crab rolls and unfortunately the meat was obviously spoiled.  Only had one mouth full. The rainbow sushi roll we got also tasted of fish past it's best.

The issue was handled well by the staff but I don't think I'll be going back. Shame as I was hopeful.

Update - reduced my rating to one star.  My wife now has food poisoning.  I now recommend that you avoid this restaurant.  Will be reporting to the authorities
